results.evidenceText: Organization: Gênero e Número. Official call. Fellowship: Programa de Bolsas Aborto em Pílulas; five projects receive R$5,000 each. Applications close on 27 November 2026 at 23:59, after opening on 10 November 2026. Eligibility: journalists or communicators resident in Brazil, women cis/trans/travestis, trans men, transmasculine and non-binary people, with proven experience covering reproductive justice; individual or duo projects; active MEI or ME required for invoicing.
results.reason: Falha de rede; tentar em auditoria futura.
